projects.name: Project 1: Digital Insurance Claims & Policy Management Platform: TD Insurance
details: Technology:
Java 8, Spring Boot, REST, Microservices, Kafka, AWS (EKS, EC2, S3, RDS), Docker, JPA, Kubernetes, Jenkins, React.js, Git, Maven
Responsibilities:
Designed and developed scalable backend microservices.
Built REST APIs for claims, policy, and customer workflows.
Implemented Kafka-based event-driven architecture.
Deployed applications on AWS EKS with auto-scaling and monitoring.
Integrated backend APIs with React.js frontend.
